planSteps.description: Enter the word KALEM using the on-screen keyboard and press the enter key; repeat this 6 times in total until the 6 rows are used up and the game ends
Click the button with id 'serbest' (it appears in the element with id 'sonuc' once the game is over)
The element with id 'mod-etiketi' shows the text '(serbest)'
The grid with id 'izgara' is empty again with 6 rows of 5 cells
